name: Valleria
title: Grand Magister

onTalk.when: cond 20; NOT level >= 76; !((npcId == 30176) && st.isCompleted()); player.getClassId().getId() == getPrevClass(player)

villagemaster/30176.htm.text: Grand Magister Valleria: Nice to meet you. I am Grand Magister Valleria, responsible for transforming Wizards into high-level Sorcerers here in this Ivory Tower. Hey, Did you come here to learn how to freely manipulates the power of the elements themselves?

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/0-01.htm.text: Grand Magister Valleria: To become an Archmage you have to transcend your life as a Human and live as a god. You must unlock the power of the gods , sealed long ago to prevent Humans from accessing it.

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/0-04.htm.text: Grand Magister Valleria: To become an Archmage, you must receive the contents of six Tablets of Vision . They are scattered about the world. Meet Magister Justin of Goddard Castle Town , he'll tell you what to do next.

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/0-06.htm.text: Grand Magister Valleria: You communed with them all? You seek the truth. I'll tell you... I have had many disciples, all of which have died pursuing this great power. Until now. I didn't want you to have the same fate, so I sent the fallen angel to stop you. I tried myself at the last tablet, but D…

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/0-09.htm.text: Grand Magister Valleria: You've done well. I bestow upon you the title of Archmage!

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/0-010.htm.text: Grand Magister Valleria: I can't allow you to become an Archmage yet! (Class transfer is allowed only for characters of level 76 or above. Do not abandon quest before transfer is complete!)
when: cond 20; NOT level >= 76; !((npcId == 30176) && st.isCompleted()); player.getClassId().getId() == getPrevClass(player)

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/0-02.htm.text: Grand Magister Valleria: I still think Archmage is beyond your reach. (This quest may only be undertaken by a character level 76 or above.)

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/0-03.htm.text: Grand Magister Valleria: To put it simply, you can't just read the text on the Tablet of Vision, you must have a Stone of Commune . It gives you a direct transmission of the knowledge if you commune with the tablet . This stone is quite rare, but has been sighted recently. Ask Magister Justin of Go…

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/0-05.htm.text: Grand Magister Valleria: The gods sealed the Tablets of Vision and scattered them all over the world. If you commune with all six, you shall obtain great power! Once you do that, I'll grant you Archmage status. It won't be easy.

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/0-07.htm.text: Grand Magister Valleria: When we battled, I realized you had become better than all my previous disciples. You can handle yourself now, I see that. That's why I withdrew. It's time to release you from my care. Forgive me, but I had good intentions. I now bestow upon you the title of Archmage!

Q00088_SagaOfTheArchmage/0-08.htm.text: Grand Magister Valleria: When we battled, I realized you had become better than all my previous disciples. You can handle yourself now, I see that.
